_doc: One-time unlocks. kind: demon (resource = DemonData .tres), weapon (resource = weapon .tscn; a locked weapon never appears in the level-up pool unless it is the demon's starting weapon), ability (id checked by the ability owner via Progression.is_unlocked(id)). Anything NOT listed here is unlocked by default. requires: {upgrade_or_unlock_id: level}.

unlocks.name: Bind Morvane
unlocks.description: Break the seal on Morvane's prison and let her walk with you.

unlocks.name: Bind Skarn
unlocks.description: Skarn answers only to those who have already bound one of his kin.

unlocks.name: Bind Ysolde
unlocks.description: Her chains were forged of hellstone. So must the key be.

unlocks.name: Bind Nhazgul
unlocks.description: The hive does not want a master. Feed it enough sin and it will settle for a partner.

unlocks.name: Bind Iscariel
unlocks.description: He betrayed Heaven once. Pay him in hellstone, and pray he finds Hell's terms more agreeable.

unlocks.name: Forge: Infernal Chain
unlocks.description: Adds the Infernal Chain to the boons you may be offered in a run.

unlocks.name: Forge: Reaper's Scythe
unlocks.description: Adds the Reaper's Scythe to the boons you may be offered in a run.

unlocks.name: Grimoire: Wraith Host
unlocks.description: Learn to call the Wraith Host. It may now be offered at level-ups.

unlocks.name: Grimoire: Infernal Storm
unlocks.description: Learn the Infernal Storm. It may now be offered at level-ups.

unlocks.name: Grimoire: Harvest of Souls
unlocks.description: Learn the Harvest of Souls. It may now be offered at level-ups.

unlocks.name: Grimoire: Tempest Crown
unlocks.description: Forge the Tempest Crown. It may now be offered at level-ups.
